prerequisites: Basic knowledge of electrical engineering and electronic components

learning_outcomes.text: Students know power electronic components and the significance of their parameters.
Students who have successfully completed this module know the topology of basic power electronic circuits and can explain their behavior.
Students who have successfully completed this module can select a suitable converter circuit, calculate its steady-state operating points, and dimension the required components.
Students can verify the calculation of steady-state operating points using simulations and measurements on real systems.
Students who have successfully completed this module can analyze, solve, and document a problem in a group and present the results.

syllabus_topics: Mains-commutated converter three-phase bridge circuit AC/three-phase converter
Self-commutated converter DC converter pulse inverter
assessment_rules: The graded examination performance can be either an oral exam or a written exam. The duration for the oral exam is defined in the general part of the examination regulations. The scope for the written exam is defined in the respective valid study regulations. The ungraded examination performance is an experimental work, consisting of approximately 2 experiments in total.
